coverage.join: a snapshot is used only when its as_of is at or before the plan date and within the age bound; every joined value carries the age that was used

kpi.reading: this counts a decision with at least one joined snapshot; no single source reaches half the book, and the per-source figure on each card is the one that says whether that source was there

signal_panel.method: cross-sectional rank IC per session, averaged; interval bootstrapped over sessions; directional hit rate only where the direction was registered in advance
signal_panel.interval_caveat: intervals are clustered by session but not corrected for overlapping forward windows: t5 and especially t20 bands are optimistic, t1 is not affected

degradation.cost: signal snapshot kept for the most recent 300 decisions; older ones keep their action, outcome and place on the timeline
